categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies private broadcast outbound connection management in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy timing side channel in private transaction broadcast where adversaries returning a transaction quickly could cancel remaining outbound connections and correlate broadcasts. Resolving timing attacks directly addresses transaction origin privacy, though the attack vector is theoretical.
